#/properties/rotors.rationale: M3 here means the Army and Air Force Enigma I, with a pool of five rotors. The naval rotors VI-VIII are left for an M4 spec; until it exists they are unknown components.

#/properties/reflector.rationale: B was standard; C saw limited wartime use. Reflector A was replaced before the war and is left out.

#/properties/rings.rationale: Letters, not key-sheet numbers, so every key member uses one alphabet. Converting 01-26 to A-Z is a population concern.

#/properties/positions.rationale: The machine is modeled without the indicator procedure: the caller supplies the start position directly. Indicators and the sloppy-operator habits are an operator layer, not yet specified.

#/properties/plugboard.rationale: Ten cables was Army practice from 1939. Fewer were valid and used earlier, so 0 to 10 pairs are accepted. The keyspace peaks at 11 pairs, which is why the limit is a real parameter.
